A few useful answers.

Can I add a battery to my existing solar?

Potentially. Compatibility depends on your inverter, existing system and installation. Choose “Battery” in the quote tool and tell us you already have solar.

How accurate is the savings estimate?

The roof outline calculates the horizontal area on live satellite imagery. Results show separate solar and extra battery benefits using illustrative assumptions, not a site assessment or live energy model. Actual savings depend on shading, roof orientation, tariffs, energy use and system design. An installer needs to assess your property before providing a quote.

Can I request general electrical work?

Yes. Use the general electrical quote form to describe the work, your location and preferred timing.
